Hey just reaching out to confirm if my order will be shipped out in batch 1?

Been waiting for a while now lol
Note to the team: I'll pull up the order first.
Handed to the team · Order past its revised ship date (Oct 15) with no firm new date I can state; bat

Hi John,

Yes, your B30 is in batch 1. That is the group we told you about on September 15, with the mid October window, and your order is still sitting in it.

Where it stands now: batch 1 has finished production and left China, and it is on its way to our warehouses. The mid October window has slipped while it is in transit, so rather than give you a day I cannot stand behind, a colleague is confirming the exact ship out date for your unit today and will come back to you here. You can follow that incoming shipment on our shipment status page at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Your free Power Kit and the Miner Duster are already on the order and ship in the same box as the miner, at no cost to you. Your price stays locked at what you paid.

Sorry it has taken this long, and thanks for being patient with us.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hey yes thank you I did receive the email.
Any idea when it will ship out to me?

Hi John,

Glad that reached you.

Here is where it stands. Your unit is in batch 1, which has left the factory. The U. share of that batch is booked into our US warehouse for around November 13. Your B30 ships out to (address hidden) as soon as it is checked in there, which usually takes a few days after the pallets land, and you will get the tracking by email the moment the label is made.

Your Power Kit and Miner Duster are already on the shelf and reserved for you, so they go out in the same box as the miner at no cost.

You can watch that shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

If the arrival moves, I will write to you rather than leave you guessing. Thanks again for your patience on this one.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
